tierReasoning: A viewer-only bug fix: the H.264 keyframe SPS gains a VUI that says frames are never reordered, so Chrome on a Mac stops holding up to 12 frames before the first picture. Pure byte rewrite limited to Baseline SPS without a VUI; no server, helper, protocol or route change.

causalAutopsy.notes: The Mac and Windows encoders write a Baseline SPS with no VUI; Chrome assumes reordering up to MaxDpbFrames (Studio reading 2026-11-27 21:13 PT: 10 decodes, 0 outputs).
